low-calorie-0-paneer-tawa.title: Paneer tawa sauté with cucumber
ingredients: Oil spray or ½ tsp oil only
steps: Prep: Pat Paneer dry. Chop cucumber + onion. Mix jeera-dhania with a pinch of salt.
Heat pan on medium. Add the listed oil.
Cook Paneer (tawa sauté) until done — about 5–8 mins.
Add cucumber + onion. Toss 2–3 mins so veggies stay bright.
Off heat, add lemon. Optional: 1 phulka or ½ cup rice if it fits your day.
Plate and eat within 20–30 mins. Reheat leftovers only once.
low-calorie-0-paneer-tawa.tips: Measure oil. Add extra cucumber for volume without many calories.
tasteTweaks: Want more flavour? Finish with lemon and a pinch of jeera-dhania.
If you like spicy: add ½ green chilli or red chilli flakes while cooking.
If you do NOT like spicy: skip chilli; use black pepper + lemon only.
Optional boost: 1 tsp hung curd or a few roasted peanuts for crunch.
Meal-prep: keep spice temper / dressing separate; mix just before eating.
